dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I've never heard your voice before... Are you a traveler who came here to participate in Weinlesefest?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Welcome. I hope you enjoy the festival as much as I do.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Although I can't see to celebrate with everyone else, this festival brings me the best news of all: that all is well with the Knights of Favonius' expedition...
